endorsements.quote: An ideal future is one in which AI provides a well-validated supplement to clinical care while remaining under the supervision and scrutiny of those with appropriate medical training so as to provide evidence-based, equitable care.

unlisted_practices: Establish regulatory oversight for AI-related research and practice in mental health to ensure quality and equity.
Clinicians should take an active role in AI research, development, ethical commentary, and regulation.
Involve physicians in leadership or liaison roles in AI-focused work groups within health systems.
Engage physician informaticists to help health systems decide between custom and off-the-shelf AI solutions and whether implementation is likely to provide value.
Require AI therapy services to demonstrate clinical efficacy, feasibility, and trust before adoption.
Do not use the availability of AI services as an excuse to reduce in-person mental health services.

screen.reason: Editorial discussing the promises, pitfalls, regulatory oversight, governance, and ethical deployment of AI in mental healthcare.
